narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>All hens give one hundred ten legs, and forty legs are extra. That means forty horses.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it. Forty horses and fifteen hens have one hundred ninety legs.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is far too many, because one horse brings only two extra legs.

narration: <bookmark mark='heads'/>To check, add your horses and hens. They must give the number of heads.
